text_or_value: The voice assistant often misunderstands place names and natural requests while driving.
I want the navigation to plan charging and breaks better on long trips.
The seats are comfortable, but I miss easier adjustment profiles when my partner drives.
The app takes too long to show whether the car is locked and the climate setting was accepted.
Parking in older city garages is stressful because the camera view is hard to interpret.
Road noise is too noticeable on the motorway; I would value a quieter cabin.
The rear passengers need more useful charging ports and clearer climate controls.
Competitors make it easier to find charging stops that match the driver's preferred network.
I like the smooth ride and how confident the car feels on wet roads.
Customers expect driver assistance to explain clearly when lane support is unavailable.
More customers ask about electric range and public charging convenience.
Most sampled journeys are under 40 km, with regular motorway trips at weekends.
